events: An observer turns one superficial cue into an absolute judgment about a coordinator's operational competence.
A directly observable routing decision contradicts that exact operational judgment and has a visible result.
Additional evidence stays within its supported scope; the closing detail humanizes the coordinator without undoing the correction.
A skilled athlete is introduced as skilled from the first shot.
A montage repeats the already accepted skill without contradicting any prior proposition.
A comic ending changes tone but not the interpretation of earlier evidence.
